statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have used the skills I have developed in the expressive arts to contribute to a public presentation/performance.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have experienced the energy and excitement of presenting/performing for different audiences.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have experienced the energy and excitement of being part of an audience for other people’s presentations/performances.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have experimented with a range of media and technologies to create images and objects, using my understanding of their properties.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have continued to experiment with a range of media and technologies, handling them with control and assurance to create images and objects. I can apply my understanding of the properties of media and of techniques to specific tasks.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use and combine the visual elements and concepts to convey ideas, thoughts and feelings in expressive and design work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use the visual elements and concepts with sensitivity to express qualities and relationships and convey information, thoughts and feelings. I can use my skills and creativity to generate original ideas in my expressive and design work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Through observing and recording, I can create material that shows accuracy of representation.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Through creating a range of reference material, I can demonstrate my skills of observing and recording and apply them to work in other areas of the curriculum.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Having chosen personal themes and developed my own ideas from a range of stimuli, I can express and communicate my ideas, thoughts and feelings through 2D and 3D work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: While working through a design process in response to a design brief, I can develop and communicate imaginative design solutions.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: By working through a design process in response to a design brief, I can develop and communicate imaginative and original design solutions.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can respond to the work of artists and designers by discussing my thoughts and feelings. I can give and accept constructive comment on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can analyse art and design techniques, processes and concepts, make informed judgements and express considered opinions on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have created and taken part in dance from a range of styles and cultures.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can apply my performance skills to dance with accuracy, control, body awareness, sensitivity and movement flow. I can communicate my artistic intention and take account of different audience groups.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can apply theatre arts technology to add excitement and drama to performances.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can select ideas from a range of stimuli to choreograph dance motifs in creative ways.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can participate in dance styles and activities which challenge and extend my repertoire of movement and my knowledge of the styles and cultures of dance.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can respond to the experience of dance by discussing my thoughts and feelings. I can give and accept constructive comment on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can analyse technical aspects of dance, make informed judgements and express personal opinions on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can create, develop and sustain a realistic or stylised character through the use of voice, movement and language.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can demonstrate sensitivity, precision and depth in the portrayal of a character, conveying relationships and situations in a variety of settings and to different audiences.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: In response to a variety of stimuli, I can use my understanding of characterisation to create characters using different approaches, making use of voice, movement and language. I can present my work to an audience.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Having developed ideas from a range of stimuli, I can contribute to devising, rehearsing and presenting drama or scripts.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Having had opportunities to lead negotiation and decision making, I can work on my own and with others to devise, rehearse and refine dramas and scripts.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use theatre arts technology to enhance tension, mood and atmosphere in drama work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can respond to the experience of drama by discussing my thoughts and feelings. I can give and accept constructive comment on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can analyse technical aspects of drama and scripts, make informed judgments and express considered opinions on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can sing and/or play music from a range of styles and cultures and perform my chosen music confidently using performance directions, musical notation and/or playing by ear.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can give assured, expressive and imaginative performances of vocal and/or instrumental music from a wide range of styles and cultures, using performance directions, musical notation, and/or playing by ear.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use my voice, musical instruments or music technology to improvise or compose with melody, rhythm, harmony, timbre and structure.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use my chosen vocal and/or instrumental skills to improvise and compose, showing developing style and sophistication.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use music technology to compose, record and produce music and to enhance performance.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Having developed my ideas from a range of stimuli, I can create and present compositions using a broad range of musical concepts and ideas.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have listened to a range of music and can identify features and concepts. I can give constructive comments on my own and others’ work, including the work of professionals.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Having reflected on my personal experiences, including participation and engagement with professionals, I can listen to a wide range of music and identify and analyse technical aspects, make informed judgments and express personal opinions on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I am aware of and able to express my feelings and am developing the ability to talk about them.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I know that we all experience a variety of thoughts and emotions that affect how we feel and behave and I am learning ways of managing them.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand that there are people I can talk to and that there are a number of ways in which I can gain access to practical and emotional support to help me and others in a range of circumstances.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand that my feelings and reactions can change depending upon what is happening within and around me. This helps me to understand my own behaviour and the way others behave.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I know that friendship, caring, sharing, fairness, equality and love are important in building positive relationships. As I develop and value relationships, I care and show respect for myself and others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand the importance of mental wellbeing and that this can be fostered and strengthened through personal coping skills and positive relationships. I know that it is not always possible to enjoy good mental health and that if this happens there is support available.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I am learning skills and strategies which will support me in challenging times, particularly in relation to change and loss.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand that people can feel alone and can be misunderstood and left out by others. I am learning how to give appropriate support.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: As I explore the rights to which I and others are entitled, I am able to exercise these rights appropriately and accept the responsibilities that go with them. I show respect for the rights of others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: I recognise that each individual has a unique blend of abilities and needs. I contribute to making my school community one which values individuals equally and is a welcoming place for all.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: I make full use of and value the opportunities I am given to improve and manage my learning and, in turn, I can help to encourage learning and confidence in others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: Representing my class, school and/or wider community encourages my self-worth and confidence and allows me to contribute to and participate in society.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: Through contributing my views, time and talents, I play a part in bringing about positive change in my school and wider community.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: I value the opportunities I am given to make friends and be part of a group in a range of situations.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I am developing my understanding of the human body and can use this knowledge to maintain and improve my wellbeing and health.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I am learning to assess and manage risk, to protect myself and others, and to reduce the potential for harm when possible.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I know and can demonstrate how to keep myself and others safe and how to respond in a range of emergency situations.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I know and can demonstrate how to travel safely.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am developing the skills and attributes which I will need for learning, life and work. I am gaining understanding of the relevance of my current learning to future opportunities. This is helping me to make informed choices about my life and learning.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Based on my interests, skills, strengths and preferences, I am supported to make suitable, realistic and informed choices, set manageable goals and plan for my further transitions.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am investigating different careers/occupations, ways of working, and learning and training paths. I am gaining experience that helps me recognise the relevance of my learning, skills and interests to my future life.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Movement skills, competencies and concepts
statements.text: As I encounter new challenges and contexts for learning, I am encouraged and supported to demonstrate my ability to select, adapt and apply movement skills and strategies, creatively, accurately and with control.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Movement skills, competencies and concepts
statements.text: As I encounter a variety of challenges and contexts for learning, I am encouraged and supported to demonstrate my ability to select and apply a wide range of complex movement skills and strategies, creatively, accurately and with consistency and control.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Movement skills, competencies and concepts
statements.text: I practise, consolidate and refine my skills to improve my performance. I am developing and sustaining my levels of fitness.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Movement skills, competencies and concepts
statements.text: I can organise my time to practise, consolidate and refine my skills to achieve my highest quality performance in a range of contexts. I am developing and sustaining my level of performance across all aspects of fitness.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Cooperation and competition
statements.text: I am developing the skills to lead and recognise strengths of group members, including myself. I contribute to groups and teams through my knowledge of individual strengths, group tactics, and strategies.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Cooperation and competition
statements.text: While learning together, and in leadership situations, I can: • experience different roles and take responsibility in organising a physical event • contribute to a supportive and inclusive environment • demonstrate behaviour that contributes to fair play.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Evaluating and appreciating
statements.text: I can analyse and discuss elements of my own and others’ work, recognising strengths and identifying areas where improvements can be made.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Evaluating and appreciating
statements.text: I can: • observe closely, reflect, describe and analyse key aspects of my own and others’ performances • make informed judgements, specific to an activity • monitor and take responsibility for improving my own performance based on recognition of personal strengths and development needs.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and sport
statements.text: I am experiencing enjoyment and achievement on a daily basis by taking part in different kinds of energetic physical activities of my choosing, including sport and opportunities for outdoor learning, available at my place of learning and in the wider community.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and sport
statements.text: I continue to enjoy daily participation in moderate to vigorous physical activity and sport and can demonstrate my understanding that it can: • contribute to and promote my learning • develop my fitness and physical and mental wellbeing • develop my social skills, positive attitudes and values • make an important contribution to living a healthy lifestyle.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and sport
statements.text: I have investigated the role of sport and the opportunities it may offer me. I am able to access opportunities for participation in sport and the development of my performance in my place of learning and beyond.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and sport
statements.text: I can explain the role of sport in cultural heritage and have explored the opportunities available for me to participate in school sport and sporting events. I make use of participation and performance pathways that allow me to continue and extend my sporting experience in my place of learning and beyond.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and health
statements.text: I can explain why I need to be active on a daily basis to maintain good health and try to achieve a good balance of sleep, rest and physical activity.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and health
statements.text: I can explain the links between the energy I use while being physically active, the food I eat, and my health and wellbeing.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and health
statements.text: I have investigated factors which can influence participation in physical activity and food choices, and the impact of activity on population health in the Scottish and wider contexts. I can use this information to discuss policies and inform my own health choices.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I enjoy eating a diversity of foods in a range of social situations.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: By taking part in practical food activities and taking account of current healthy eating advice, I can prepare healthy foods to meet identified needs.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Having researched food and health policy, and dietary legislation, I can explain how this impacts on individuals, the community and the world of work.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Through practical activities using different foods and drinks, I can identify key nutrients, their sources and functions, and demonstrate the links between energy, nutrients and health.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I can apply my knowledge and understanding of nutrition, current healthy eating advice and the needs of different groups in the community when planning, choosing, cooking and evaluating dishes.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am developing my understanding of the nutritional needs of people who have different conditions and requirements.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Having identified diet-related conditions, I can adapt and cook recipes to suit individual needs.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Having assessed how lifestyle or life stages can impact on people’s nutritional needs, I can explain how these needs are met.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Safe and hygienic practices
statements.text: I can apply food safety principles when buying, storing, preparing, cooking and consuming food.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Safe and hygienic practices
statements.text: Having explored the conditions for bacterial growth, I can use this knowledge to inform my practice and control food safety risks.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: Having explored a range of issues which may affect food choice, I can discuss how this could impact on the individual’s health.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: Having investigated the effects of food processing on the nutritional value of foods, I can critically assess the place of processed foods in a healthy balanced diet.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: Using my knowledge of nutrition and current healthy eating advice, I can evaluate the information on food packaging, enabling me to make informed choices when preparing and cooking healthy dishes.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: I have examined and evaluated food packaging and can understand the legal requirements for manufacturers.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: By investigating different influences on the consumer, I can discuss how consumers can be influenced by external sources.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: I can explain basic legal rights and responsibilities of the consumer, recognising the agencies that can help.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand the positive effects that some substances can have on the mind and body but I am also aware of the negative and serious physical, mental, emotional, social and legal consequences of the misuse of substances.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know that popular culture, the media and peer groups as well as my own attitudes and values can influence how I feel about substance use and recognise the impact this may have on my actions.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Through investigation, I can explain how images of substance use and misuse can influence people’s behaviour.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am developing a range of skills which can support decision making about substance use. I can demonstrate strategies for making informed choices to maintain and improve my health and wellbeing and can apply these in situations that may be stressful or challenging, or involve peer pressure.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know how to access information and support for substance-related issues.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: After assessing options and the consequences of my decisions, I can identify safe and unsafe behaviours and actions.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know that the use of alcohol and drugs can affect behaviour and the decisions that people make about relationships and sexual health.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know the action I should take in the management of incidents and emergencies related to substance misuse.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand the impact that ongoing misuse of substances can have on a person’s health, future life choices and options.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Through investigating substance misuse in my local community I can reflect on specific issues, and discuss how they are being addressed.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: By researching the impact of substance misuse nationally and internationally I can explain similarities and differences among communities.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand the local, national and international impact of substance misuse.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand the importance of being cared for and caring for others in relationships, and can explain why.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand and can demonstrate the qualities and skills required to sustain different types of relationships.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand and can explain the importance of, and need for, commitment, trust and respect in loving and sexual relationships. I understand the different contexts of such relationships including marriage.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I recognise that power can exist within relationships and can be used positively as well as negatively.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am aware of the need to respect personal space and boundaries and can recognise and respond appropriately to verbal and non-verbal communication.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I reflect on how my attitudes, beliefs, values and morality can influence my decisions about friendships, relationships and sexual behaviour.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know that popular culture, the media and peer pressure can influence how I feel about myself and the impact this may have on my actions.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am developing skills for making decisions about my relationships and sexual behaviour. I am able to apply these to situations that may be challenging or difficult.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand my own body’s uniqueness, my developing sexuality, and that of others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Using what I have learned I am able to make informed decisions and choices that promote and protect my own and others’ sexual health and wellbeing.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know how to access services, information and support if my sexual health and wellbeing is at risk. I am aware of my rights in relation to sexual health including my right to confidentiality, and my responsibilities, including those under the law.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know how to manage situations concerning my sexual health and wellbeing and am learning to understand what is appropriate sexual behaviour.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know where to get support and help with situations involving abuse and I understand that there are laws which protect me from different kinds of abuse.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I can explain the importance and the enduring and complex responsibility of being a parent/carer, and the impact on life choices and options.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I can explain the support and care necessary to ensure a child is nurtured through the different stages of childhood.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Through investigation I can explain the support available for parents and carers looking after babies and bringing up children.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: By developing my knowledge of how a classical language works, I can analyse straightforward sentences or short passages and translate them into appropriate English.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: By applying my understanding of grammatical processes in a classical language, I can analyse more complex sentences and longer passages and translate them into appropriate and accurate English.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: Individually and with others, I have used a range of resources and applied analytical skills. I can find specific information in a grammatically-straightforward passage in a classical language.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: I can use a range of resources, and apply analytical skills to find specific information and the main ideas or themes of a passage in a classical language and make evaluative judgements, orally and in writing.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: By applying my awareness of how classical Greek has linguistic links with English or Latin with English and other modern European languages which are based on Latin, I can enhance the range of my vocabulary and increase my confidence in communicating in English.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: Through an awareness of features common to classical Greek and English, or Latin and English and other languages, I have enhanced the range of my vocabulary and increased my confidence in communicating in English. I can discuss how language reflects the thoughts, feelings and needs of different societies in the past and today.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: I have investigated the culture and heritage of the Greeks or Romans through language and literature. I can demonstrate my knowledge of their cultures by contributing to an oral or written presentation on their influences on the heritage of modern Scotland and the wider world.

statements.subject: Classical languages
statements.text: I have evaluated the culture and heritage of the Greeks or Romans through language and literature. I can demonstrate understanding of how their cultures have impacted in different ways on the culture and life in modern Scotland and the wider world through an oral or written presentation of my research.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening for information
statements.text: I can listen to and show understanding of mainly familiar language and instructions from a variety of sources where the sentences are longer and where there may be more than one speaker.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening for information
statements.text: I can listen to and show understanding of language from a variety of sources, including unfamiliar speakers, where the sentences are more complex, less predictable, and contain some unfamiliar language.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can listen and respond to others in mainly predictable, more extended conversations using familiar language and/or non-verbal techniques.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can listen and respond to others, including sympathetic fluent speakers of the language, in extended conversations that are less predictable.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can take part effectively in prepared conversations by using a variety of language structures to share information, experiences and opinions, and can offer straightforward reasons for having these opinions.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can take part effectively in more detailed conversations using an extended range of language structures and Gaelic idioms to exchange information, experiences, feelings and opinions, and can offer more detailed reasons for having these opinions.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can support a conversation by asking for help, seeking repetition and asking simple questions.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can start, support and sustain a conversation by, for example, asking relevant questions and seeking help when necessary.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can participate in a range of collaborative activities in Gaelic including games, paired speaking and structured role plays in a range of realistic contexts and settings.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can collaborate to prepare and present in Gaelic more open-ended role plays in a wide range of realistic settings, and I can engage with other speakers of Gaelic.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Organising and using information
statements.text: I have contributed successfully to a group to plan and prepare a short talk in Gaelic. Using ICT where appropriate, I can deliver an individual presentation in Gaelic: • on an area of personal interest or a topic relating to Gaelic culture or history • using appropriate vocabulary and some variety in sentence structure.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Organising and using information
statements.text: Using ICT where appropriate, I can plan, prepare and deliver an individual presentation in Gaelic: • on an area of personal interest or a topic relating to Gaelic culture or history • using appropriate vocabulary and a range of grammatical structures and idiom.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Using knowledge about language
statements.text: I can apply my knowledge about language, intonation and pronunciation to: • ensure that others can understand me when I pronounce familiar words or phrases • help me work out how to pronounce unfamiliar words • read a short text aloud with accuracy and confidence.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Using knowledge about language
statements.text: I can apply my knowledge about language, intonation and pronunciation to: • ensure that others can understand me when I pronounce familiar and unfamiliar words and phrases • help me work out how to read aloud familiar and unfamiliar texts with accuracy and confidence.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I have worked on my own and with others to understand texts using appropriate resources. I can read and demonstrate understanding of more complex texts which contain familiar and unfamiliar language.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: Using a variety of resources, I can independently read texts which are more detailed and which contain complex language, including a range of tenses and Gaelic idiom, and can demonstrate my understanding.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I have worked on my own and with others to read and explore Gaelic texts. I can demonstrate my knowledge about life and culture in countries where Gaelic and related languages are spoken.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I have worked on my own and with others to read and research Gaelic texts. I can demonstrate my knowledge of different cultures and acknowledge similarities/differences between countries where Gaelic and related languages are spoken.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Reading: Reading for interest and enjoyment
statements.text: I have chosen and can read for enjoyment a range of texts, in a variety of styles, which may have had some adaptation.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Reading: Reading for interest and enjoyment
statements.text: I can select and read for enjoyment a variety of texts which use familiar and unfamiliar language and may have had some adaptation.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can use a bilingual dictionary independently to help me understand new language.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can use my knowledge about language and other strategies to help me to understand and analyse more detailed texts containing some unfamiliar language and more complex structures.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can recognise features of words in the language I am learning and use them to make sense of vocabulary and of the connections between words.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can create, amend and present more extended information for different purposes about myself and others, my experiences or a topic of my choice. I can write simple facts about life in some of the countries where Gaelic and related languages are spoken.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can write about life or culture in countries where Gaelic and related languages are spoken.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can express opinions and can offer straightforward reasons for having these opinions.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can write more extensively over a widening range of topics in a range of formats, using some variety of structures, tenses and linking words.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can write about experiences, feelings and opinions and can offer reasons for having these opinions.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can check the accuracy of my writing using my knowledge about language, the support of others, and appropriate reference materials including success criteria.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can use my knowledge about language, including structure, spelling and punctuation, to take responsibility for the accuracy of my writing.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I identify situations of wonder and mystery in life. Having considered the belief that these situations are signs of God’s invitation to relationship, I can describe how they affect our awareness of the sacred in our lives.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I consider the Catholic belief that the human nature of every person is fundamentally open to God, who calls each person to relationship and fullness of life. I can describe how this affects our awareness of the importance and the presence of God in our daily lives.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Catholic Christianity: In the Image of God
statements.text: I have considered the Christian vision of the dignity of the human person, made in the image and likeness of God. I have reflected upon how this has contributed to my becoming the person I am today.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Catholic Christianity: In the Image of God
statements.text: I can describe how the Christian vision of the human person has affected our understanding of the experience of life as a journey towards fulfilment in God. I have reflected on and can describe my sense of vocation in life.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Catholic Christianity: Revealed Truth of God
statements.text: I have examined the way that God is revealed in the lives of key people and events described in the Old Testament.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Catholic Christianity: Revealed Truth of God
statements.text: I have examined key events in the New Testament where God is revealed as Father, Son and Holy Spirit. I have considered how this affects my understanding of the nature of God.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that Jesus is truly divine and truly human and I can acknowledge Him as our Saviour who brings the New Covenant.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have explored the Christian belief that in Jesus, God enters and transforms human nature, and exists at the centre of all creation.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have researched into the social, political and religious life in Jesus’ land 2000 years ago to develop my understanding of Jewish expectations of the Messiah.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: Having examined key events during the Ministry, Passion, Death and Resurrection of Jesus and the beginnings of the Church, I can describe how these events, and the influence of the Holy Spirit, affected: • the early Christian communities’ understanding of Jesus’ nature • His continuing presence and identity • the development of the Church.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have reflected upon the centrality and significance of the death and resurrection of Jesus to the Christian understanding of Jesus as Son of God and Son of Man. I can describe how this has affected my own and others’ understanding of and belief in Jesus.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have reflected upon the significance of the Sacraments in the life of the community of Faith. I can describe how these provide important encounters with Jesus throughout life.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can describe how my understanding of the Sacraments affects my own and others’ understanding of the ways that the Sacraments (especially Eucharist, as the source and summit of Christian life) make Christ present to nourish and support our relationships with God and each other.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have explored the belief that the Holy Spirit inspires and empowers the Church to fulfil its prophetic and missionary role in our world today. I have researched into situations which bear witness to this. I can describe how I and others can contribute to this work.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: To help me understand the message intended by the writers of the Biblical texts I have developed an awareness of literary forms in the Bible.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have considered the belief that God speaks to us in Sacred Scripture and in Sacred Tradition as expressed in the ongoing life and teaching of the Church. I can describe how these have affected my own and others’ understanding of the truth and meaning of life.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can describe what I believe Biblical texts say about the way that God spoke to people in the past and how God speaks to people today.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that a good background understanding of the New Testament is important for living as a Christian today.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I recognise the importance of personal prayer and communal prayer in the growth of all people’s relationship with God. I know a number of traditional Catholic prayers and I have developed an understanding of the meaning of these prayers. I have participated in different approaches to, and experiences of, prayer. I can describe how prayer is an important part of the liturgical and devotional life of the Church. I have reflected on how all of these are different ways of worshipping God.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can explain the place of Mary in the Church’s Liturgy and in the prayer life of individual Christians. I can also explain the place of Mary in other Christian traditions.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can recognise the Mass as both a sacred meal and a sacrifice and I have reflected on what this means for human salvation.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have explored the meaning of ritual and symbol within the Sacred Liturgy of the Church.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have considered the liturgical events of Holy Week, Easter, Advent and Christmastide. I can reflect critically on the central importance of the feast of Easter in the Church’s Liturgical Calendar.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have reflected on the Ten Commandments and the teachings of Christ. I have acted on Christ’s personal challenge to contribute to the creation of a transformed world of Justice, Love and Peace, through the power of the Holy Spirit.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have experienced what it means to be wise and compassionate. I can describe how these experiences have affected my understanding of my value as a person, my awareness of the needs of others and my willingness to contribute to the service of the common good.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have explored the call to forgiveness and reconciliation and have reflected on how this can restore my relationship with God and others. I can put this understanding into practice in my relationship with God and others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have considered the need for reconciliation in situations in society.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have developed awareness of the elements essential for making informed decisions and I have examined situations which pose a moral challenge in life. I can describe and explain my response and the responses of others to these situations.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have experienced opportunities to engage with issues of social injustice. I can describe how Church teaching in this area has affected my response and the responses of others to these issues.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can describe how a sense of the sacred affects the everyday living of people of various faiths. I can also describe how my understanding of this has influenced my respect for the faith of others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have researched into the origins of the key beliefs of different world faiths. I can describe and evaluate different beliefs about human nature and destiny, the problems of evil and suffering, and life after death.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can confidently express my own beliefs on these issues.

statements.text: I have researched and I can describe the moral attitudes and values of the major world religions.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools

statements.text: I have researched into and I can identify the core values at the heart of the major world faiths.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Other world religions: Values and issues
statements.text: I can relate these to my own values.

statements.strand: Other world religions: Values and issues
statements.text: I can describe how this has developed my awareness of the commonality of values across major world faiths. I can evaluate the importance these values hold for the good of the individual and stability of society.

statements.text: I have researched the major ceremonies and customs of other world faiths. I can explain the significance of these to the followers of these beliefs.

statements.text: Through researching the traditions, practices and customs of major world religions, I have developed my understanding of them and my respect for people of other faiths.

statements.text: I have explored how people of other world faiths practise their beliefs today. I can relate these to my own faith practice.

statements.text: I can describe the place of religious practice in Scotland and in the contemporary world at large.

statements.text: I can use my knowledge of the different ways in which heat is transferred between hot and cold objects and the thermal conductivity of materials to improve energy efficiency in buildings or other systems.

statements.subject: Sciences

statements.text: By contributing to an investigation on different ways of meeting society’s energy needs, I can express an informed view on the risks and benefits of different energy sources, including those produced from plants.

statements.subject: Sciences

statements.text: By investigating renewable energy sources and taking part in practical activities to harness them, I can discuss their benefits and potential problems.

statements.subject: Sciences

statements.text: Through investigation, I can explain the formation and use of fossil fuels and contribute to discussions on the responsible use and conservation of finite resources.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Planet Earth: Processes of the planet
statements.text: By contributing to experiments and investigations, I can develop my understanding of models of matter and can apply this to changes of state and the energy involved as they occur in nature.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Planet Earth: Processes of the planet
statements.text: I have developed my understanding of the kinetic model of a gas. I can describe the qualitative relationships between pressure, volume and temperature of gases.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Planet Earth: Processes of the planet
statements.text: I can explain some of the processes which contribute to climate change and discuss the possible impact of atmospheric change on the survival of living things.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Planet Earth: Processes of the planet
statements.text: Through exploring the carbon cycle, I can describe the processes involved in maintaining the balance of gases in the air, considering causes and implications of changes in the balance.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By using my knowledge of our solar system and the basic needs of living things, I can produce a reasoned argument on the likelihood of life existing elsewhere in the universe.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By researching developments used to observe or explore space, I can illustrate how our knowledge of the universe has evolved over time.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By contributing to investigations of energy loss due to friction, I can suggest ways of improving the efficiency of moving systems.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can use appropriate methods to measure, calculate and display graphically the speed of an object, and show how these methods can be used in a selected application.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By making accurate measurements of speed and acceleration, I can relate the motion of an object to the forces acting on it and apply this knowledge to transport safety.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I have collaborated in investigations into the effects of gravity on objects and I can predict what might happen to their weight in different situations on Earth and in space.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can help to design and carry out investigations into the strength of magnets and electromagnets. From investigations, I can compare the properties, uses and commercial applications of electromagnets and supermagnets.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Through experimentation, I can explain floating and sinking in terms of the relative densities of different materials.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Having measured the current and voltage in series and parallel circuits, I can design a circuit to show the advantages of parallel circuits in an everyday application.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Through investigation, I understand the relationship between current, voltage and resistance. I can apply this knowledge to solve practical problems.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By contributing to investigations into the properties of a range of electronic components, I can select and use them as input and output devices in practical electronic circuits.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Using my knowledge of electronic components and switching devices, I can help to engineer an electronic system to provide a practical solution to a real-life situation.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can help to design simple chemical cells and use them to investigate the factors which affect the voltage produced.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Using experimental evidence, I can place metals in an electrochemical series and can use this information to make predictions about their use in chemical cells.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Using a variety of sources, I have explored the latest developments in chemical cells technology and can evaluate their impact on society.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Forces, electricity and waves: Vibrations and waves
statements.text: By recording and analysing sound signals, I can describe how they can be manipulated and used in sound engineering.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Forces, electricity and waves: Vibrations and waves
statements.text: By exploring the refraction of light when passed through different materials, lenses and prisms, I can explain how light can be used in a variety of applications.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Forces, electricity and waves: Vibrations and waves
statements.text: By carrying out a comparison of the properties of parts of the electromagnetic spectrum beyond the visible, I can explain the use of radiation and discuss how this has impacted upon society and our quality of life.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Forces, electricity and waves: Vibrations and waves
statements.text: By exploring radiations beyond the visible, I can describe a selected application, discussing the advantages and limitations.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I have explored the structure and function of organs and organ systems and can relate this to the basic biological processes required to sustain life.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I can explain how biological actions which take place in response to external and internal changes work to maintain stable body conditions.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I have explored the role of technology in monitoring health and improving the quality of life.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: Through investigation, I can explain how changes in learned behaviour due to internal and external stimuli are of benefit to the survival of species.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: Using a microscope, I have developed my understanding of the structure and variety of cells and of their functions.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: By researching cell division, I can explain its role in growth and repair and can discuss how some cells can be used therapeutically.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I have contributed to investigations into the different types of microorganisms and can explain how their growth can be controlled.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I have taken part in practical activities which involve the use of enzymes and microorganisms to develop my understanding of their properties and their use in industries.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I have explored how the body defends itself against disease and can describe how vaccines can provide protection.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I can debate the moral and ethical issues associated with some controversial biological procedures.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I understand the processes of fertilisation and embryonic development and can discuss possible risks to the embryo.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Through investigation, I can compare and contrast how different organisms grow and develop.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I have extracted DNA and understand its function. I can express an informed view of the risks and benefits of DNA profiling.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Through evaluation of a range of data, I can compare sexual and asexual reproduction and explain their importance for survival of species.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can use my understanding of how characteristics are inherited to solve simple genetic problems and relate this to my understanding of DNA, genes and chromosomes.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: I have developed my knowledge of the Periodic Table by considering the properties and uses of a variety of elements relative to their positions.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: Through gaining an understanding of the structure of atoms and how they join, I can begin to connect the properties of substances with their possible structures.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: Having contributed to a variety of practical activities to make and break down compounds, I can describe examples of how the properties of compounds are different from their constituent elements.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: I can differentiate between pure substances and mixtures in common use and can select appropriate physical methods for separating mixtures into their components.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: I have carried out research into novel materials and can begin to explain the scientific basis of their properties and discuss the possible impacts they may have on society.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: I have taken part in practical investigations into solubility using different solvents and can apply what I have learned to solve everyday practical problems.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: Through evaluation of experimental results, I can demonstrate my understanding of conservation of mass.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Through evaluation of a range of data, I can describe the formation, characteristics and uses of soils, minerals and basic types of rocks.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I have explored how different materials can be derived from crude oil and their uses. I can explain the importance of carbon compounds in our lives.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can participate in practical activities to extract useful substances from natural resources.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Having taken part in practical activities to compare the properties of acids and bases, I have demonstrated ways of measuring and adjusting pH and can describe the significance of pH in everyday life.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can monitor the environment by collecting and analysing samples. I can interpret the results to inform others about levels of pollution and express a considered opinion on how science can help to protect our environment.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Through experimentation, I can identify indicators of chemical reactions having occurred. I can describe ways of controlling the rate of reactions and can relate my findings to the world around me.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can collect and analyse experimental data on chemical reactions that result in an obvious change in energy. I can apply my findings to explain the significance of the energy changes associated with chemical reactions.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I have helped to design and carry out practical activities to develop my understanding of chemical reactions involving the Earth’s materials. I can explain how we apply knowledge of these reactions in practical ways.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Having carried out a range of experiments using different chemicals, I can place metals in an order of reactivity, and relate my findings to their everyday uses.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I have collaborated with others to find and present information on how scientists from Scotland and beyond have contributed to innovative research and development.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I have researched new developments in science and can explain how their current or future applications might impact on modern life.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Through research and discussion, I have contributed to evaluations of media items with regard to scientific content and ethical implications.

statements.subject: Sciences
